messages:
maya: Quick Q — where's the canonical LogSearch saved views for per-org/model/route filters? Debugging a spike of 5xxs for acme on /v1/generate in eu region. Anyone have a saved query I can copy? :eyes:

sam: There's a saved view — 'acme-eu-5xx-by-route' in LogSearch. Dashboard link: https://logs.redwood.internal/app/logs/saved/acme-eu-5xx-by-route
Also check: Dashboards > Observability > Log Search > Saved views.

maya: perfect, ty. Is there a minimal query snippet I can paste into the search bar to tweak time window?

jon: Use this to start (filter by org/model/route/region/status):
```
org_id:acme AND region:eu AND route:"/v1/generate" AND status:[500 TO 599]
| sort @timestamp desc
```
You can add `model:gpt-neox` or `model:"redwood/opt-13b"` as needed.

lina: If you're going to create a saved search, name it `acme/eu /v1/generate 5xx` and include tags: org:acme, region:eu, type:5xx. Also, for alerts, raise to infra if sustained >10% 5xx over 5m. I filed a quick alert-tuning PR: https://git.redwood/internal/alerts/PR-472

obs-bot: Saved view found and attached: https://logs.redwood.internal/app/logs/saved/acme-eu-5xx-by-route — last updated by sam 2026-02-12 09:14UTC

maya: linked and running. Will ping if I need help. Thanks all! :thumbsup:

sam: Happy to pair for 10m if you want.
